title: block-windows-drive-tmp telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the block-windows-drive-tmp guard. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "block-windows-drive-tmp". Evolves additive-only. Carries NO full command string.

tool.description: The invoking tool — "Bash" or "PowerShell"; this guard matches both.

subject.description: Privacy-safe command subject: `Bash:<first-token>` for a Bash call, with leading sudo / env-assignment prefixes stripped and the token basenamed; the bare tool name (`PowerShell`) for a PowerShell call, which is not tokenized. NEVER the full command or its arguments.

form.description: The matched form when blocked: "redirect" | "write-utility" | "too-long" (command exceeded the parse cap and was blocked fail-closed). Empty string when the command was allowed (status ok).
